text:
julia: Quick heads-up — discovered a client header mismatch in the v2 preview that will break a small subset of SDK users. Can owners please call out blockers and minimal mitigation?

kevin: tagging in. I own the router shim for v2 -> v1 fallback. What header is failing?

julia: Header is `X-Redwood-Client: v2` — older SDKs send `X-Redwood-Client: v2-preview`. Some proxies route by exact header. Repro in staging when calling the /generate endpoint.

maria: sdk here — we pushed a patch that normalizes variations but it's only in beta. Current stable SDKs won't tolerate both. We can backport a tolerant parser to stable, but it'd be a tiny release (patch).

tess: runtime note — we do have a fallback rule that maps `v2-preview` to `v2` for traffic routing, but the proxy layer upstream (api-gateway) strips unknown headers early when strict-mode is enabled. So we need either gateway tweak or SDK/backport.

andrew: from PM side: what's the user impact? Are customers losing functionality or just seeing 400s? Need to decide messaging.

julia: Impact is intermittent 400s for clients that still use the `v2-preview` token header; affects ~2% of traffic in canary slices. No data loss, just failed requests.

kevin: Plan suggestion: short-term: deploy a gateway rule to accept both header variants. Medium-term: coordinate a stable SDK patch and a quick client upgrade campaign. Which teams can do the gateway change?

maria: SDK can cut patch today if we get sign-off. We'll open PR to backport the tolerant parser to 1.12.x. Need QA window.

tess: ops: I can flip the gateway to permissive matching for the header for the next 2 hours during the canary window. After that we revert and rely on SDK rollout. Who will monitor errors?

julia: I'll own monitoring for the next 4 hours. I'll add a temporary metric for mismatched-header 4xxs and post alerts to #incidents if >50/min.

kevin: I'll prepare the router shim change in case gateway rollback causes issues. PR link shortly: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/482 (WIP)

maria: PR for SDK backport: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1975 — tests passing locally, CI queued. Requesting a fast-track merge + publish to npm/pypi.

andrew: I'll draft a short customer note if we see >100 impacted users. Otherwise we'll include this in the next weekly status.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: gateway-permissive-header-change -> canary -> 3578200200 by tess.

julia: Next steps checklist: 1) tess flips gateway permissive (now scheduled) 2) maria merges and publishes SDK patch 3) kevin readies router shim as backup 4) julia monitors and reports.

kevin: ack — I'll queue the shim PR for review and tag @platform-oncall.

maria: ack — will post publish link when done. ETA ~45m.

tess: gateway change live in canary at 3578200200. Reverting plan in place for 3578202000 if no issues.

julia: Monitoring shows drop from ~30/min 4xx -> ~3/min after change. Will keep watching.

andrew: thanks all. If metrics stay green, let's schedule SDK announcement tomorrow to nudge customers.

julia: closing loop later today with final incidence numbers. Thanks :thumbsup:
